clips.title: The story
paras: Dwarven warriors and hunters train at the Hall of Arms in Ironforge’s Military Ward. Its command staff oversees the city’s forces, while steam tanks and flying machines are prepared for battle.

The Hall of Arms commands Ironforge’s armed forces from the southeastern corner of the Military Ward. Warriors and hunters train there under veteran instructors, while the facility stores and stages machines of war. Steam tanks are assembled and maintained on site for Alliance battlefields. Gyrocopters and flying machines travel up industrial conveyor belts, then launch through shafts in the cavern ceiling toward the Ironforge Airfield above.
